decisions.decision: Added env_file: .env to docker-compose backend service
decisions.rationale: Many .env keys were silently never reaching container; env_file ensures all keys available without manual enumeration

decisions.decision: download_assets_post_commit now updates CreativeAsset.asset_url after downloading
decisions.rationale: Harmonizer ran before downloads so CreativeAsset.asset_url was always empty; propagating after download fixes the timing gap

decisions.decision: detail dialog always calls loadDetail() even with preloaded data
decisions.rationale: Preloaded path used stale cache forever; background refresh gives instant render + eventually fresh data

decisions.decision: Frontend requires docker-compose up --build to ship TS changes (no hot-reload unlike backend)
decisions.rationale: Angular is pre-compiled at image build time, not mounted as volume
